feature_descriptions.covers_group_by: 1 if index order satisfies GROUP BY
feature_descriptions.covers_order_by: 1 if index order satisfies ORDER BY after the equality prefix
feature_descriptions.equality_prefix_length: Leading index columns matched by equality/IN predicates
feature_descriptions.existing_prefix_ratio: Leading columns already indexed by an existing index / column count
feature_descriptions.has_range_column: 1 if the column after the equality prefix is a range predicate
feature_descriptions.is_covering: 1 if the index contains every column the supporting query reads
feature_descriptions.join_usage_ratio: Supporting executions using the leading column as a join key / supporting executions
feature_descriptions.leading_selectivity: Distinct leading-column values / table rows, missing if unavailable
feature_descriptions.log_avg_latency_ms: ln(1 + mean latency of supporting executions in ms)
feature_descriptions.log_estimated_index_mib: ln(1 + heuristic index size estimate in MiB), missing if unavailable
feature_descriptions.log_leading_cardinality: log10(1 + distinct leading-column values), missing if unavailable
feature_descriptions.log_median_latency_ms: ln(1 + execution-weighted median of supporting query medians)
feature_descriptions.log_p95_latency_ms: ln(1 + max supporting P95), missing when fewer than 20 samples
feature_descriptions.log_table_rows: log10(1 + table row count), missing if unavailable
feature_descriptions.order_usage_ratio: Supporting executions whose ORDER BY the index satisfies / supporting executions
feature_descriptions.supporting_query_count: Distinct query templates the candidate supports
feature_descriptions.time_share: Supporting latency / total latency in the query log
feature_descriptions.where_usage_ratio: Supporting executions using the columns in WHERE / supporting executions
feature_descriptions.workload_share: Supporting executions / all executions in the query log
feature_descriptions.write_ratio: Write executions / all executions on the table in the captured workload
